recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-17756; newer Goal status issues should be evaluated separately if they arise.
issue_request: FHIR-17756 was a Published Patient Care change request with a Persuasive with Modification resolution to replace Goal.status with Goal.lifecycleStatus, a mandatory lifecycle code with required binding, and Goal.achievementStatus, an optional achievement CodeableConcept with preferred binding.
initial_application: The change was explicitly applied by bb582cddb3fe, which replaced Goal.status in the Goal spreadsheet/examples and added the achievement terminology and status-code entries. Later refactors moved the authoritative Goal content into structuredefinition-Goal.xml and bundle-Goal-search-params.xml while preserving the split.
additional_context: Goal is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source contains Goal.lifecycleStatus as 1..1 code with required binding to ValueSet/goal-status and Goal.achievementStatus as 0..1 CodeableConcept with preferred binding to ValueSet/goal-achievement. Later FHIR-55326 added an unknown lifecycle code, and later FHIR-53981 renamed separate status metadata elements; those differences do not undo or conflict with FHIR-17756.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the authoritative current source, search parameters, examples, and terminology references already implement the requested split, and no obsolete Goal.status element remains in current Goal source.

related_jiras.note: Added the unknown Goal.lifecycleStatus code in 2026, explaining the extra current lifecycle code.
